notes.title: How to support this visual novel
notes.notes: [p]Hello, my friend.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm in a pretty bad financial situation currently, all things considered. [/p][p]So any support would be greatly appreciated.[/p][p]Consider supporting me on patreon:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/c/Denhop/membership" style="button" buttoncolor="#b7804e"]Set Yourself on Fire on Patreon[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I also plan on releasing a DLC, which will feature developer commentary and some extra content. A percentage of that revenue will be given to the musicians who have contributed to the soundtrack. [/p][p][/p][p]The VN will remain free.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your consideration.[/p][p][/p][p]I've been working quite a lot on this project.
